items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: In Chicago, we were at the Cabaret where Earl Hines used to be for years.

ctx.x: When the lyrics come along, it brings about a new title, then. Uh huh. Now back to Moonlite Fiesta -- do you remember how you happened to write that or where you were?
Well, I played it myself on the trombone at the house in Chicago. In Chicago, we were at the Cabaret where Earl Hines used to be for years.
